sql: SELECT 'funnel' AS what, to_char(created_at,'HH24:MI') AS k, 'F='||COALESCE((raw_json->'per_book'->>'Fmmsell10'),'0')||' Fpt='||COALESCE((raw_json->'per_book'->>'Fmmsell10_pt4'),'0')||' m10='||COALESCE((raw_json->'per_book'->>'mmsell10'),'0')||' opened='||COALESCE(raw_json->>'opened','?')||' ccap='||COALESCE(raw_json->>'skipped_contest_cap','?')||' tier='||COALESCE(raw_json->>'skipped_live_tier','?')||' paused='||COALESCE(raw_json->>'skipped_live_paused','?')||' inband='||COALESCE(raw_json->>'in_band','?') AS v FROM system_events WHERE component='mmsell_scan' AND created_at > now() - interval '25 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT 'live_orders_since_arm', COALESCE(strategy,'-')||' '||COALESCE(status,'?'), count(*)::text FROM live_orders WHERE created_at > timestamptz '2026-09-07 02:01:35+00' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'new_paper_rows', strategy, count(*)::text FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy IN ('Fmmsell10','Fmmsell10_pt4') GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'open_pos', strategy, count(*)::text FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy IN ('Emmsell10','Emmsell10_pt4','Fmmsell10','Fmmsell10_pt4','mmsell10') AND closed_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
